{{Top|leg}}
A '''Kroyn'Tra''' was a military unit formation within the [[Mercenary Guild of Coyn/Legends|Mercenary Guild of Coyn]], equivalent to an [[Army/Legends|army]]. The Mercenary Guild maintained thirty Kroyn'Tra, with eight hundred thousand [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] spread unevenly amongst them.<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|Special Military Unit Intelligence Update}}</ref>
